function.name: hospital_locate
function.description: Locate nearby hospitals based on location and radius. Options to include specific departments are available. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Denver, CO

department.description: Specific department within the hospital. Default to none if not provided.
